chains.title: Alt C disrupts ARID5B repressor binding at an FTO intron-1 adipocyte enhancer, derepressing IRX3/IRX5
chains.element: FTO intron 1 (~chr16:53.767 Mb) conserved enhancer active in preadipocytes/adipocytes
chains.target_gene: IRX3 and IRX5 (long-range targets, not FTO itself)

links.claim: The ref T allele creates an AT-rich motif bound by the ARID-family repressor ARID5B; the alt C allele weakens this binding. ARID5B chosen within the AT-rich ARID binding group because it is the ARID member expressed in adipose progenitors and reported at this locus; coverage in QBiC-SELEX not checked here.
The variant sits in a conserved enhancer within FTO intron 1 that loops to the IRX3/IRX5 promoters; loss of ARID5B occupancy converts the element from repressed to active.
Enhancer derepression raises IRX3 and IRX5 expression in cis during early adipocyte differentiation.
The effect is restricted to adipocyte precursors at the beige/white fate decision window, not to mature adipocytes or brain.
Higher IRX3/IRX5 shifts cells from beige thermogenic to white lipid-storing programme (lower UCP1, lower mitochondrial respiration), increasing fat mass and BMI.

predictions: ARID5B ChIP or EMSA shows allele-specific occupancy favouring T
CRISPR repair C->T in risk-allele adipocytes restores UCP1 and respiration
ARID5B knockdown on the T allele phenocopies the C allele
IRX3/IRX5, not FTO, show allelic expression imbalance
falsified_if: No allele-specific ARID5B binding by EMSA/ChIP
Editing the single base changes no gene expression
IRX3/IRX5 unchanged while FTO itself is the only cis-regulated gene

chains.title: Null: rs1421085 is a passenger in a strong LD block and another variant carries the causal regulatory effect
predictions: Single-base editing of rs1421085 alone changes no target gene expression
MPRA shows no allelic activity for this variant but does for a neighbouring LD partner (e.g. rs1558902, rs9939609, rs8050136)
No allele-specific TF occupancy at this position
falsified_if: Isogenic single-base edit of C->T reverses IRX3/IRX5 expression and the cellular phenotype
Reproducible allele-specific TF binding at this exact base

chains.title: Alt C creates/strengthens a CUX1 (CUT-homeodomain) site that activates the same enhancer

links.claim: The C allele generates a CUT/homeodomain-like site; CUX1 chosen within that specificity group as the broadly expressed family member in adipose tissue. QBiC coverage not checked.
Gain of an activator at the intron-1 element increases enhancer output rather than relieving repression.
IRX3/IRX5 transcription rises through activator recruitment.
Acts in preadipocytes where CUX1 (p110/p200 isoforms) is present.
Same downstream white-adipocyte shift and increased adiposity.

predictions: CUX1 knockdown lowers IRX3/IRX5 specifically on the C allele
Reporter with C allele is more active only when CUX1 is co-expressed
falsified_if: No CUX1 binding at the element
Knockdown of CUX1 has no allele-specific effect
Allelic effect is loss-of-binding rather than gain

chains.title: Allelic effect on a CTCF/cohesin-dependent contact that changes FTO-IRX3 looping
chains.element: Intron-1 element acting as a loop anchor within the FTO TAD

links.claim: Ref T supports stronger CTCF occupancy at a nearby anchor; alt C weakens it. CTCF is the sole TF with this specificity, so no within-group choice is needed. Coverage not checked.
Weakened anchor changes enhancer-promoter contact frequency across the ~1 Mb FTO-IRX3 domain.
IRX3 promoter gains contact with distal enhancers, raising its expression.
Loop architecture differences manifest in adipose lineage where the enhancers are active.
Elevated IRX3 reduces thermogenesis and increases adiposity.

predictions: Allele-specific CTCF ChIP-seq signal at the variant
Cohesin depletion abolishes the allelic expression difference
falsified_if: No CTCF motif or occupancy at the variant
Allelic effect persists after cohesin depletion

chains.title: Variant acts on FTO itself via an adipose promoter-proximal regulatory element
chains.element: FTO intron-1 element acting on the FTO promoter

links.claim: Alt C improves an IRF-family site; IRF4 chosen within the IRF specificity group because it is the IRF member with an established adipocyte lipolysis/thermogenesis role. Coverage not checked.
The element behaves as an FTO-proximal enhancer rather than a long-range IRX3 enhancer.
FTO mRNA levels change in cis in adipose tissue.
Effect seen in mature adipocytes where IRF4 is abundant.
Altered FTO m6A demethylase activity changes adipogenesis and energy intake, raising BMI.

predictions: FTO shows allele-specific expression in adipose, IRX3/IRX5 do not
FTO eQTL colocalises with the obesity signal in adipose
falsified_if: No FTO eQTL at this variant in adipose
IRX3/IRX5 but not FTO show allelic imbalance

matrix.test: EMSA/allele-specific ChIP for ARID5B with T vs C oligos from adipocyte progenitor nuclear extract

outcomes.outcome: No ARID5B difference; any gained complex is on C
No allelic difference with any extract

matrix.test: Isogenic CRISPR single-base conversion (C->T) in human adipocyte progenitors, then RT-qPCR of IRX3, IRX5, FTO, UCP1

outcomes.outcome: IRX3/IRX5 down, UCP1 up; FTO unchanged
IRX3/IRX5 down, dependent on CUX1 levels
IRX3 down with altered looping; FTO may also shift

matrix.test: MPRA/luciferase of 150 bp T vs C element in preadipocytes

outcomes.outcome: C allele more active (loss of repression)
C allele more active on an FTO-promoter reporter

matrix.test: Allele-specific CTCF ChIP-seq in heterozygous adipose cells

next_experiment: Run a low-cost allele-specific EMSA with supershift (anti-ARID5B, anti-CUX1) using T and C oligos and preadipocyte nuclear extract: a T-preferential ARID5B complex supports H1, no allelic complex at all supports the null H5, and a C-preferential CUX1 complex supports H2.
